cases.sentence: Я человек, испытавший горе, от жезла гнева ___.
cases.translation: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of the Lord's wrath.
cases.explain: The genitive case 'жезла гнева Господа' shows possession: 'the rod of the Lord's wrath.'

cases.sentence: Он погнал меня и ввел во ___, а не в свет.
cases.translation: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
cases.explain: The preposition во (into) with accusative case indicates motion into a place.

cases.sentence: Он состарил кожу мою и плоть мою, сокрушил ___ мои.
cases.translation: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.
cases.explain: The verb сокрушил (broke) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Окружил меня стеной, чтобы я не мог выйти, заковал меня в тяжелые ___.
cases.translation: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; He has weighed me down with chains.
cases.explain: The verb заковал (bound) takes the instrumental case to show what the person was bound with.

cases.sentence: Натянул он свой лук и сделал меня мишенью для стрел ___.
cases.translation: He has bent his bow and made me a target for His arrows.
cases.explain: The genitive case 'стрел колчана' (arrows from the quiver) shows the source.

cases.sentence: Помню лишь о страдании и скитании, во мне лишь горечь и ___.
cases.translation: I remember my affliction and my wandering. Within me is bitter sorrow.
cases.explain: After the conjunction и (and), 'желчь' is parallel to 'горечь' in the predicate.

cases.sentence: Милость Господа никогда не иссякает, сострадание Его не истощается. Они обновляются каждое ___.
cases.translation: The Lord's compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
cases.explain: The phrase 'каждое утро' (every morning) uses the accusative case for time expressions.

cases.sentence: Я сказал себе, Господь — часть моя, потому я буду надеяться на ___.
cases.translation: I said to myself, The Lord is my portion; therefore I will hope in Him.
cases.explain: After the preposition на (on/upon) in accusative, the pronoun becomes него.

reading.ru: Я человек, испытавший горе, от жезла гнева Господа.
reading.question: What is the speaker's experience?
options: He has seen affliction by the rod of the Lord's wrath
reading.correct: He has seen affliction by the rod of the Lord's wrath
reading.explain: The verse states: Я человек, испытавший горе, от жезла гнева Господа (I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of the Lord's wrath).

reading.ru: Но вот что говорю я себе, вот что дает мне надежду. Милость Господа никогда не иссякает.
reading.question: What gives the speaker hope?
reading.explain: The text says: Милость Господа никогда не иссякает (The Lord's compassions never fail).

reading.ru: Они обновляются каждое утро, велика верность Твоя.
reading.question: How often are the Lord's compassions renewed?
reading.explain: The verse states: Они обновляются каждое утро (They are new every morning).

reading.ru: Я сказал себе, Господь — часть моя, потому я буду надеяться на Него.
reading.question: What has the speaker decided about the Lord?
options: The Lord is my portion, therefore I will hope in Him
reading.correct: The Lord is my portion, therefore I will hope in Him
reading.explain: The speaker declares: Господь — часть моя, потому я буду надеяться на Него (The Lord is my portion, therefore I will hope in Him).

reading.ru: Благо тому, кто молча ожидает спасения от Господа.
reading.question: What is good, according to this verse?
options: To wait quietly for salvation from the Lord
reading.correct: To wait quietly for salvation from the Lord
reading.explain: The text says: Благо тому, кто молча ожидает спасения от Господа (Good is the man who waits quietly for the salvation of the Lord).

reading.ru: Ведь не по изволению сердца своего он приносит бедствие и горе людям.
reading.question: Does the Lord willingly cause suffering to people?
options: No, not by His will does He afflict or bring sorrow
reading.correct: No, not by His will does He afflict or bring sorrow
reading.explain: The verse states: не по изволению сердца своего он приносит бедствие (not from his heart does He afflict).
